enhancements.name: Damage
enhancements.description: Unlocked for free after Workshop Enhancements are researched. Starts at 1x and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a max of 400 levels for x5.

enhancements.name: Rend Max
enhancements.description: Requires 50 billion coins to be spent on damage enhancements to unlock. Applies a multiplier to Rend Max, chance, and Mult  of x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 5x bonus.

enhancements.name: Critical Factor
enhancements.description: Requires 500 billion coins to be spent on enhancements to unlock. Increases Crit Factor by 1.0x when unlocked and increases by 0.1 per level. Has 400 levels for a maximum of x5.

enhancements.name: Health
enhancements.description: Health enhancement is unlocked for free after completing the Workshop Enhancement Labs. Increases Health by x1.0 when unlocked and increases by 0.1 per level. Has a maximum of 400 levels for a multiplier of x5.00.

enhancements.name: Health Regen
enhancements.description: Requires 50 billion coins to be spent on defense enhancements to unlock. Increases the health regen multiplier by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 5x bonus.

enhancements.name: Wall Health
enhancements.description: Requires 50 trillion coins to be spent on defense enhancements to unlock. Increases Wall Health by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 5x bonus.

enhancements.name: Land Mine Damage
enhancements.description: Requires 5 trillion coins to be spent on defense enhancements to unlock. Increases Land Mine Damage multiplier by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.06x per level. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 25x bonus.

enhancements.name: Defense Absolute
enhancements.description: Requires 500 billion coins to be spent on defense enhancements to unlock. Increases the Defense Absolute multiplier by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 5x bonus.

enhancements.name: Cash Bonus
enhancements.description: Cash Bonus enhancement is unlocked for free after completing the Workshop Enhancement Labs. Increases the Cash Bonus multiplier by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. The Cash workshop enhancement also increases the cash per wave, interest percentage, and max interest per wave amount by 1% each upgrade as well. Has a maximum level of 400 for a 5x bonus.

enhancements.name: Coin Bonus
enhancements.description: Requires 50 billion coins to be spent on Utility enhancements to unlock. Increases the Coin Bonus multiplier by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 200 for a 3x bonus. Note: Coin Bonus enhancement affects tier bonus and Coins/kill. This means the overall benefit of Coin Bonus enhancement is squared.

enhancements.name: Free Upgrades
enhancements.description: Requires 5 trillion coins to be spent on Utility enhancements to unlock. Increases all Free Upgrades by x1 when unlocked and increases by 0.01x per level. Has a maximum level of 100 for a 2x bonus.
